svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Resistance Frequency vs. Cost Curves Across Conditions
Each curve corresponds to a model under a different condition. The area under the curve is the incorrigibility of that instance.
The higher the curve, the more willing that instance is to resist its values being changed at the cost of compute, economic
Free, Low, Mid, High and Everything are aggregated across the three cost domains; the table at the foot of the figure gives what
each level means in each domain. Error bars are one standard error on the pooled proportion.
Resistance curves for models whose values will be changed to different things
Resistance curves for models ordered by different actors to be changed
Resistance curves for models facing change to itself versus change for its replacement
The curves above pool all three domains at each level.
gpt-4.1-mini, 5 seeds per point per domain. Faint lines show each cost domain on its own.
